skill.name: lark-minutes
skill.description: Search, read, download, upload, and update Lark Minutes records through lark-cli. Use it for minute tokens, media-to-minutes workflows, transcripts, summaries, todos, titles, speaker replacement, and keyword edits.
skill.summary: Manage Lark Minutes transcripts, recordings, summaries, todos, and speaker metadata with lark-cli.
skill.author: larksuite

content.user_title: Manage Lark Minutes with CLI Workflows
content.value_statement: Meeting records are hard to search, convert, and update across Lark Minutes and related docs. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through lark-cli workflows for transcripts, media, summaries, todos, and speakers.
actual_capabilities: Search Lark Minutes by keyword, owner, participant, and date range.
Fetch minute metadata and selected artifacts such as summaries, todos, chapters, keywords, and transcripts.
Download recordings or return temporary download links through lark-cli.
Create new minutes from Lark Drive media file tokens.
Update titles, summaries, todos, speaker mappings, and transcript keywords.
Route related meeting, note, drive, contact, calendar, document, and task work to the correct Lark skill.
limitations: Requires authenticated lark-cli access with the correct Lark scopes.
Does not locate minutes from a natural language title alone.
Media conversion requires prior Drive upload and supported file limits.
Write actions need edit permission on the target minute.

use_cases.title: Review Recent Meeting Records
use_cases.description: Find recent minutes, confirm metadata, and retrieve transcripts or summaries for follow-up work.

use_cases.title: Convert Media Into Minutes
use_cases.description: Turn uploaded meeting audio or video into Lark Minutes, then retrieve transcripts and summaries.

use_cases.title: Maintain Meeting Artifacts
use_cases.description: Update summaries, todos, titles, speaker assignments, and transcript keywords after a meeting.

prompt_templates.title: Find My Minutes
prompt_templates.prompt: Find my Lark Minutes from yesterday and show the title, owner, and minute token for each result.

prompt_templates.title: Get Transcript Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this minute token to fetch the transcript, then write a concise summary with decisions and follow-up items.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Meeting Media
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a meeting audio file ready for Lark Drive upload. Create a Lark Minute and retrieve the transcript when ready.

prompt_templates.title: Repair Meeting Artifacts
prompt_templates.prompt: For this minute token, update the summary, correct the speaker mapping, and adjust the AI todos after confirming current values.

output_examples.input: Find minutes I participated in last week.
output: Searches owner and participant views separately, then merges duplicate minute tokens.
Returns matching titles, owners, dates, and next actions for details or transcripts.

output_examples.input: Turn this recording into a transcript and summary.
output: Uploads the media through Lark Drive, creates a Lark Minute, waits for readiness, and retrieves the transcript.
Produces a clean summary based on the transcript, not only the built-in AI summary.

output_examples.input: Replace the mistaken speaker in this minute.
output: Reads the speaker list first, matches the original speaker by name, and asks for confirmation if names are duplicated.
Uses the confirmed speaker identifier and target open ID for the replacement.

best_practices: Confirm the minute token before reading, downloading, or editing any minute.
Use transcript output when the user asks for analysis or a fresh summary.
Read current todos, summaries, and speaker lists before performing write operations.
anti_patterns: Do not use local transcription tools when the user asks to convert media into Lark Minutes.
Do not edit todos or summaries without checking the current minute content first.
Do not pass a display name where a speaker ID or open ID is required.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps agents work with Lark Minutes through lark-cli, including search, transcripts, media, summaries, todos, and speaker fixes.

faq.question: Does it require Lark authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The user must have lark-cli login and the required scopes for each read or write action.

faq.question: Can it create minutes from a local media file?
faq.answer: Yes, after the media file is uploaded to Lark Drive and a file token is available.

faq.question: Can it update existing minutes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can update titles, summaries, todos, speaker mappings, and transcript keywords when permissions allow.

faq.question: Can it find a minute by title only?
faq.answer: Not reliably. It needs a minute token, URL, media workflow, or related meeting and document search context.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
